description:
Upkeep decay brackets and decay times. Rust's dedicated-server upkeep defaults (the `decay.bracket_*` and `decay.duration_*` ConVars, as most
servers run them). `brackets` are applied in order to a base's block count: the first 15 blocks cost 10% of
their build cost per day, the next 35 cost 15%, the next 75 cost 20%, and every block beyond 125 costs 33.3%
(`blocks` null = unbounded); a base's blended daily rate is the block-weighted average of the brackets it
fills, paid in the resources each piece was built from. `decay_hours` is how long an unmaintained piece of
each grade takes to decay completely. Fixed constants, no computation happens server-side.
name: get_upkeep_rules
title: Upkeep decay brackets and decay times
